C01.resolution: Block167 uses the actual cross C=herm(U). At m=2,s_t=0 the imposed U is anti-Hermitian unitary, so C=0 and positive B gives PSD at 8x4 and 12x4 while temporal coupling is nonzero and inter-slice transport is full rank. No graph connectivity is asserted. The universal exclusion is withdrawn.

C02.resolution: The hollow-block equivalence is P PSD iff C=0 and B PSD. Full-rank anti-Hermitian transport witnesses are restricted to invertible V; zero and singular members are not called full-rank.

C03.resolution: The hop-free 2J3 row is explicit with C1 rank zero and PSD. Hop-carrying conclusions are finite rows only. The action control trace is recomputed from its own outgoing block.

C04.resolution: The Schur identity is 12x4 only, with B>0 and s_t nonzero. The s_t=0 boundary is g2-independent. The 8x6 homogeneous displacement-two map is zero rank. General P uses a generalized eigenvalue; k4/k6 are pointwise and nonuniform near zero.

C05.resolution: The mass-only map is connection-off and requires nonzero mass. The x-homogeneous unit-volume solve is a selected two-variable map. Block169 couplings are spatially constant on each time slice. Connection cancellation and more general link couplings remain open.

C06.resolution: The imposed d2 is invertible for nonzero g2 but d2 squared is nonzero, so it supplies no chain complex, cohomology, or acyclicity claim. Seven rows per fixture remain pointwise signs; the corrected check compares zero negative-eigenvalue count with the expected PSD boolean. Endpoint laws and monotonicity are withdrawn.

C07.resolution: The x-trivial forbidden-support obstruction is retained. Zero forbidden entries for x-reflecting rows are called support compatibility only; coefficient relations and positive-cone preservation remain unproved.

C08.resolution: Raw moment matrices are separated from their Hermitian parts. Hermitian-part PSD is not called raw-functional positivity. The third family is selected coefficient powers, not the full bilinear-generated star algebra. Rational brackets are endpoint signs only. The ordinary Toeplitz flag compares signed diagonal offsets.

C09.resolution: Support connectivity is tied to the substituted benchmark. Global +I and -I are both legitimate involutive commuting twists and -r negates the pairing. Four exchange-map failures do not prove reflection-positivity independence.

C10.resolution: Only finite no-supply and exact block identities remain. Traceless nonzero principal blocks, selected structure flags, fixed-carrier families, and finite censuses are not promoted to all-transport, all-variant, physical, or Hilbert-space claims.

C11.resolution: The 40-script historical theorem chain is replaced by an extracted C helper with AST provenance and one accepted A-helper import. Literal current input hashes are bound. Four historical caches and four historical manifest occurrences remain archive-only; any corrected evidence is separately identity-bound, reviewed, and accepted.
